I really hope that what I will write will neither hurt anybody, nor will let anybody thinking I am against PBD.

Completely the opposite, as I cannot say how glad I was to find out
people thinking the same way I do, and "that" is the bigger project I
will surely join and support too as far as I can.

BUT, what I want to say here is something I was thinking about lately:

"They" keep us all under "control" as we know, in all the ways we all know.

One of the ways is to "force" us to concentrate on several things to keep our thoughts far away from being any danger to them.

Now, to fight against that can be surely easier having the mind clearer from several other needs.

The biggest of those needs ? To gain money enough for giving a living to your family (at least that is what I honestly think).

So it may be "easier" to do something concrete for PBD if you just need
to concentrate one day on a chart and gain so much for living some
weeks....

The reason why most of us are probably much more active here than there
is that we all try to find the way to a certain well-bing for us, before
 thinking of others.

Wrong, I know, but true.

Instead, what we find here is that we have to understand ourselves how things work, homeworks, self "click".

We HAVE to concentrate on that, because that's a first need.

That's why if I have 1 hour "free" time, I spend it watching at charts or posts of Masters.

Trying hard to climb my way up.

Because WHENEVER I will get "there", I will be ABLE to dedicate myself to a bigger picture too.

This is a provocation, but it absolutely wants to be a positive one,as I
 will anyway use several "free" hours to that too, but I wish I could
dedicate most of my time to the future of my children and children's
children.

That's it.

author: Ifmyante
text:
That's very true!

We're caught in a trap, where we are forced into dependence on that most evil of devices; money.

However, we mostly still have the time to watch a game of football, tv, or funny kittens on youtube.

This time would be better invested in making ourselves aware of the social problems we face and the solutions to said problems.

If enough people just put in a couple of hours per week, we could change society forever.

We need not all dedicate our lives to fixing society, but there is a
bare minimum which should be done to transform us from being part of the
 problem to being part of the solution.

You usually can't go wrong with what you think is best. You need to run
 a business so you need production i.e. the horses need to drink. At

 business) maybe see what others have done to get rid of the jitters and
 give it a go with your students. I never did well under force but was

We aren't spending 8 hrs a day studying to play video games. I remind
myself of this daily. I am trading nickles and still get jittery but I
have recognized it as a problem not with emotion but with not knowing
when I'm right/wrong. This can be solved by both practice and
experience. To paraphrase a mentor of mine (think he got if from Tony
Robbins) How do we get good judgement? We get it through experience.
Experience is a nice term for failure or finding out what works;
therefore good judgement comes from correcting initial bad judgement

I think of this to try and get rid of my freezing. I am getting better
slowly and I can see progress. I should be so blessed as to have direct
 correspondence with you but I know my contribution here is out-shadowed
 by the giants around me. Therefore I look to myself to solve my
problems as you guys have. You have found your way without help and I
have your path so its on me to make it work.

I know that each person is different but I think that we all need a
nudge or sometimes a good stomping to get us to act in our own self
interest. If we're traders we must trade
 . This may not gain me any friends judging by the socialist vibe I've
seen in recent posts but I've always been taught and shown that you must
 look after yourself before you can look after others. True charity is
justice not hand outs. Money is only a claim-check to what the mind
produces. If we hate money we hate the mind and thats not what we are
fighting against. We're fighting against the misuse of money or those
who possess it through manipulation of favours not by producing
something from their own mind directly or indirectly i.e. chronie
capitalism.

At any rate look after yourself first IF. My fear is that you will
spend so much time giving to others that you will burn out. I have
nothing to offer you at present but I do not want to see you burn out as
 I think you can accomplish so much. Well talk is cheap so I better get
 back to it. Cheers.

author: nsamaroo
text:
Shift the focus and importance away from trade results and focus on process.

Profit or Loss, if a trade is identified and setup properly, and
executed with proper risk management, thats a good trade. Even if it
loses money (shit happens?). But if it loses money, the focus should be
to dig deeper and see if a mistake was made or if it was a valid trade
as per the methodology taught in the program.

That will take away some of the trigger shyness. For every trader to
have 100+ winners in a row.... possible or not, the expectation can be
crippling. If you shift the focus to the process of trading,
irrespective of the results, it'll be easier for them to do what you've
taught them so well already.

Just my 2 cents

Cheers!

author: Ifmyante
text:
I'm really not sure I can open the doors again.

I had said that the course would run for ten weeks.

Sure, that's enough time to teach the essence of the material, but
there's far more to getting students ready to trade the fund than
teaching them the rules of the market.

There's about a year at least of full time mentoring needed to do it right.

We'd probably have a better chance of staying afloat by focusing all our
 efforts on getting the students we have totally ready to trade the
fund.

I still haven't made up my mind, so please bear with me a while longer.

To answer very many PMs at once: We will not be selling the content
only, nor will we be running mini courses. We want to make fund traders!
